newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Bank gets nod for branch in Dalian, China.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank gets nod for branch in Dalian, China.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd said on Friday it had received official approval to upgrade its representative office in Dalian, China, to a branch.

The Dalian branch will offer a full range of banking services in foreign currencies and will also offer trade-related finance and other banking services, the HSBC Holdings Plc unit said in a statement.
The branch is expected to have 35 staff, up from six in the representative office. Thomas Kwok Hang Yu, chief representative of the Dalian office, will be appointed branch manager.
Dalian is a port city in the northern province of Liaoning.
In China, Hongkong Bank has branches in Beijing, Qingdao, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Tianjin and Xiamen as well as representative offices in Chengdu, Guangzhou and Wuhan.
